query:
SELECT coalesce(e.payload -> 'remainder', '[]'::jsonb) AS "remainder!: serde_json::Value"
             FROM kb_events e
             JOIN kb_event_types t ON t.id = e.event_type_id
            WHERE t.name = 'resource_erased' AND (e.payload ->> 'subject_id')::uuid = $1
            ORDER BY e.id
            LIMIT 1
